primary_family_score: unweighted mean of all 16 locked module scores per sample
primary_cross_sample_scoring: mean gene-wise z score within each locked module
rank_sensitivity_scoring: mean within-sample percentile rank of genes within each locked module
gse179730_primary_test: two-sided exhaustive responder-label permutation of responder minus non-responder paired family-score delta
gse281729_primary_test: HC3 ordinal response coefficient adjusted for HPV, second drug and author-provided doses/timing
random_control_matching: module size and gene mean-expression decile within each cohort; locked genes excluded from the sampling pool
empirical_specificity_test: two-sided absolute observed family effect versus matched random-family effects with plus-one correction
